kids.chars: trigger

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: the event that starts an evaluation, 13 types (24 §11.2), not the condition; also alert trigger_mode (24 §19.4), an order's trigger_price (24 §8.9) and an entry "trigger re-armed" (24 §8.10)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: Bybit: Conditional orders with triggerPrice, status Triggered, "Close On Trigger" (R02 §2.1; R06 §5, §10), firing on triggerBy / slTriggerBy (Last, Mark or Index price; R06 §5); TradingView: alert frequency "Once Per Bar, Once Per Bar Close, Once Per Minute" (R02 §7); DeepCharts: stops "triggered" (R04 §29)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: Med

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: qualify: "Check when", naming the price source ("Check when: each 1m bar closes"; "Check when: the last traded price changes", since on_price_update reads trade prints while a Bybit stop may trigger on Mark or Index); trigger stays in the IR, SCR-088 and the graph node (E37-D01); a rule fired, never "triggered"

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: condition

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: the boolean tree; None is false (24 E3); "Conditions (all of)" (SCR-081)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: TradingView: price-alert conditions "Crossing, Crossing Up, Crossing Down, Greater Than, Less Than" (R02 §7); DeepCharts Pattern Builder over up to 4 inputs (R04 §18); "Conditional" is an order type at Bybit and in DeepDOM (R02 §2.1; R05)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: Bybit TP/SL "Entire Position" vs "Partial Position", called "scope modes" in R02 §2.2

kids.name: c5

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: simulate

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: the standing simulate mode, no orders (24 §11.9; US-RULE-008); a run over history or a replay (22; SCR-084); auto-backtest on save (US-RULE-009); fourth, a dry run: dry_run_only on an armed rule's action (24 §11.2), read as recorded, not sent (SC-22), while 10 §6 G3 calls simulate-only "Dry-run"; beside it, demo places real demo orders, paper prices fills (24 §12), replay replays

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: TradingView "Paper Trading" and Strategy Tester (R02 §4, §9); DeepCharts "Automatic backtesting/simulation", "sim mode", "SIM accounts" (R04 §18, §21; R05); Freqtrade "Dry-run" (R07 §6)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: High

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: qualify: mode "Simulating — no orders"; SCR-084 "Simulate on recorded history"; never "backtest"; DEMO always "DEMO — real orders on Bybit's demo exchange"; a dry-run action reads "Dry run" (CA-37)

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: arm

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: six: (1) mode: armed, "the only mode that can send orders" (22); (2) "armed in simulate-only" (US-RULE-008; CMP-145; 10 §6); (3) one-click arm/lock (CMP-229; "1-click ARMED", 05 §3.1 rule 5); (4) algos (B4/B7 arming, B6 armed, arm_chase_limit); (5) alerts (B10 starts armed); (6) re-arm after a kill or error stop (B9 HUMAN_REARM) and an entry "trigger re-armed" (24 §8.10)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: Bybit: a trailing stop "becomes active/armed" at activePrice (R06 §6; R09 §6); Kryll and Hummingbot trails "arm" after a favourable move (R09 §3–§4); none recorded for TradingView or DeepCharts

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: High

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: qualify: always "Arm rule"; states "Armed · DEMO" / "Armed · LIVE" with an icon; never "armed" for simulate; re-arm is "Arm again…" through SCR-085, with a step-up on every environment (SC-21); "1-click ARMED" stays E30's (F32)

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: disarm

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: B9 DISARM, sent as mode: disabled ("Disable, simulate or arm a rule", 22); automatic: permission drift (E35 threat model RE-E1), rate breach (ADR-0007), quarantine (US-RULE-001), kill switch (US-RULE-014); near-synonyms enabled, pause_rule, PAUSED, kill_switched, "auto-disabled"

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: one-click "auto-disarm" (CMP-229); none recorded for TradingView, DeepCharts or Bybit

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: High

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: keep "Disarm" for the user's act; the state names who or what stopped the rule and whether it comes back by itself (CA-20); never show disabled
